# Bake n' Take (TypeScript)

Bake 'n take orders with this fun Discord bot!

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/bake-n-take-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Order management
- Recipe commands
- Interactive bakery experience
- TypeScript support

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
